author: chs3
quote: I honestly don't understand why Ocarina of Time gets so much praise. I tried to enjoy it, but I just found it boring. Maybe it was impressive when it first came out, but playing it today was a pretty underwhelming experience. I never really got hooked, and by the end, I was just glad it was over. It's definitely not a game I think deserved to be remade twice. I get that it's an important part of gaming history, but that doesn't automatically make it fun to play.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
